blocks.originalExcerpt: Tokenization is the critical first step that converts raw text into the discrete symbols a language model operates on. The choice of tokenizer directly affects model quality, multilingual capability, and computational efficiency.

blocks.text: 为什么是子词?字符级模型需要非常长的序列(费钱的注意)，词级模型不能处理稀有或新颖的词。副词的表示性达到了理想的平衡:常见的词是单词的表示式(“`' −[the])，稀有词分解成已知的块(“crypto mobile” −[“crypt”，“ocur”，“rence”])，词汇仍然可以管理(32K-128K 符号)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Why Subwords? Character-level models need very long sequences (expensive attention). Word-level models cannot handle rare or novel words. 虽然注意机制很强大，但它显示出了从业人员必须理解的系统性失败模式，特别是在扩展到长的背景或解释模式行为时。
blocks.originalExcerpt: While the attention mechanism is powerful, it exhibits systematic failure modes that practitioners must understand—especially when scaling to long contexts or interpreting model behaviour.

blocks.text: 现象。肖等人[393]发现Transformer模型对序列中的第一个符号分配过多的高度关注分数——不管其语义内容如何。即使第一个标志是无意义的 ‘BOS } 标记， 注意头头 在所有层次上 都一直关注它， 有时有 20 - 50% 的注意力总质量。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The phenomenon. Xiao et al. [393] discovered that transformer models allocate disproportionately high attention scores to the first token in the sequence—regardless of its semantic content. Even when the first token is a meaningless 〈BOS〉 marker, attention heads across all layers consistently attend to it, sometimes with 20–50% of total attention mass.

blocks.text: 现象。 随着序列长度n的增大，每个查询都必须在更多的密钥中分配注意力预算。每件物的平均注意力重量随着O(1/n)而下降，使模型逐渐难以集中关注一些真正相关的位置——一个称为注意力稀释或注意力扩散的问题[226]。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The phenomenon. As sequence length n grows, each query must distribute its attention budget across more keys. The average attention weight per token decreases as O(1/n), making it progressively harder for the model to concentrate on the few truly relevant positions—a problem known as attention dilution or attention diffusion [226].

blocks.text: 解释性问题。 TransformerMLP和残流中的单个神经元一般是多语义的——一个单一的神经元激活，用于多个不相关的概念(例如， " 彩色蓝色和学术引言和`the ' 一词 " )。这使得神经元级的直接解释不可靠。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The interpretability problem. Individual neurons in transformer MLPs and residual streams are typically polysemantic—a single neuron activates for multiple unrelated concepts (e.g., “the colour blue AND academic citations AND the word ‘the’”). This makes direct neuron-level interpretation unreliable.

blocks.expression: AdamW [238] fixes a subtle but important issue with how weight decay interacts with adaptive optimizers. Why L2 Regularization ̸= Weight Decay in Adam With L2 regularization, the loss becomes L + λ2 ∥θ∥2 , so the √ gradient is gt + λθt . In Adam, this regularization gradient is scaled by the adaptive factor 1/ v̂t :

blocks.expression: AdamW – Decoupled Weight Decay AdamW (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017) applies weight decay directly to the parameters, outside the adaptive scaling: m̂t θt+1 = θt − η · √ − ηλθt v̂t + ϵ √ The weight decay term ηλθt is not divided by v̂t . This gives uniform regularization across all parameters regardless of their gradient history. Typical value: λ = 0.1 for LLM training.

blocks.text: BF16 Over FP16:为什么Range Beats Precision in LLM Training BF16的引力范围与FP32相同，因此它可以代表相同的数值范围(只是mantissa的精度较低)。 FP16的动态范围小得多——梯度或激活率超过65504，引起溢出(NaN/Inf)。这就是为什么FP16训练需要损失缩放(将损失乘以一个大的常数，使梯度保持在FP16范围内)，而BF16训练一般不会。 A100和H100在本土支持BF16;除非有FP16的具体理由，否则使用BF16。

blocks.text: • 如果损失有差异(在最初减少后增加):LR过高

blocks.originalExcerpt: Flash Attention [64, 65] is one of the most impactful algorithmic innovations in deep learning since the transformer itself. blocks.originalExcerpt: Why O(n2 ) is Catastrophic The attention matrix must be written to HBM (it does not fit in SRAM for long sequences), then read back for the softmax, then read again for the P V product. Each of these HBM round-trips is slow. For n = 32768 (32K context), the attention matrix is 327682 × 2 ≈ 2 GB per head – completely infeasible to store.

blocks.title: 编者阅读提示

核心的洞察力是: 我们从不需要同时使用完整的 n × n 矩阵。 如果我们使用在线软马克斯的诡计， 我们可以逐块计算输出。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The core insight is: we never need the full n × n matrix in memory at once. We can compute the output O block-by-block if we use the online softmax trick.

blocks.text: Online Softmax。回顾软max需要全球最大数值稳定性:
blocks.originalExcerpt: Online Softmax. Recall that softmax requires a global maximum for numerical stability:

blocks.originalExcerpt: exi −m softmax(xi ) = P xj −m , m = max xj je j

blocks.text: 诀窍:当我们处理新块时， 我们可以更新运行的最大和正常化因素， 却从未实现整行。 Online Softmax Update Rule 面对运行状态( mold， lold， Oold) 和新积分的块:
blocks.originalExcerpt: The trick: we can update the running maximum and normalization factor as we process new blocks, without ever materializing the full row. Online Softmax Update Rule Given a running state (mold , ℓold , Oold ) and a new block of scores snew :

blocks.text: 1. 毫新=最大(含，含))
blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. mnew = max(mold , max(snew ))

blocks.text: 2. lnew = emold = mnew + jes new， j m new = em · − − − − − − − − − − − − − −
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. ℓnew = emold −mnew · ℓold + _jes_new,j−m_new

blocks.text: 3. Onw = l new em old m new l l l o o old+ es new m new v new l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Onew = ℓnew em_old−m_new · ℓ_old · O_old + es_new−m_new · V _new

blocks.text: 这在数学上相当于一次计算所有区块的软马克斯。
blocks.originalExcerpt: This is mathematically equivalent to computing softmax over all blocks at once.

预先培训是LLM开发中最昂贵的阶段——耗资数百万GPU小时，需要精心整理数据、计算和超参数。本节从Llama-3[118]， Chinchilla[140]和GPT-4[274]中提炼出关键的经验教训。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Pretraining is the most expensive phase of LLM development—consuming millions of GPU-hours and requiring careful orchestration of data, compute, and hyperparameters. This section distills key lessons from Llama-3 [118], Chinchilla [140], and GPT-4 [274].

blocks.title: 编者阅读提示

70B型机车的全微调需要存储70B可列车参数加上其优化状态(560+GB内存)。 LoRA [146] (Low-Rank adaption)提供了一种在达到可比质量的同时，对参数的 < 1%进行微调的方法。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Full fine-tuning of a 70B model requires storing 70B trainable parameters plus their optimizer states (560+ GB of memory). LoRA [146] (Low-Rank Adaptation) provides a way to fine-tune with <1% of the parameters while achieving comparable quality.

blocks.title: 编者阅读提示
blocks.text: 阅读 §1.9.1「洛拉洞察」 时，以页面标注的原文范围为证据边界：先确认术语定义，再追踪机制、前提、例子与限制，最后检查结论能否迁移到不同规模或不同数据条件。以下译述保留这些层次，不把编者判断混入原文。
洛拉核心思想不更新全重矩阵W Q r×d，而学习低级扰动:α W ' = W + → BA， B → Rd×r， A → Rr×d r
blocks.originalExcerpt: LoRA Core Idea Instead of updating a full weight matrix W ∈ Rd×d , learn a low-rank perturbation: α W′ = W + · BA, B ∈ Rd×r , A ∈ Rr×d r

blocks.text: • W被冻结(无梯度、无优化状态)
blocks.originalExcerpt: • W is frozen (no gradients, no optimizer states)

blocks.text: • 只有B和A受过训练:2×d×r参数而不是d2参数
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Only B and A are trained: 2 × d × r parameters instead of d2

blocks.text: • 排名r=16， d=4096:LORA增加2×4096×16=每层131K参数对16.8M参数
blocks.originalExcerpt: • At rank r = 16, d = 4096: LoRA adds 2 × 4096 × 16 = 131K params per layer vs. 16.8M for

blocks.text: • α/r 缩放控制更新的规模
blocks.originalExcerpt: • α/r scaling controls the magnitude of the update

blocks.text: 为什么Low-Rank Works Aghajanyan等人[3] 显示微调在非常低维的子空间运行——微调任务的"内在维度"远小于模型参数计数。一个175B模型的微调任务可能具有 < 1万的内在维度。 LORA直接利用了这一点: 排名r 将更新限制为每个重量矩阵的r维子空间。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Why Low-Rank Works Aghajanyan et al. [3] showed that fine-tuning operates in a very low-dimensional subspace — the “intrinsic dimensionality” of the fine-tuning task is much smaller than the model’s parameter count. A 175B model’s fine-tuning task may have intrinsic dimensionality <10,000. LoRA exploits this directly: rank r constrains the update to an r-dim...

blocks.text: 这一段原文包含从 PDF 抽取的公式、符号或表格结构，自动转写无法可靠恢复其数学排版。为避免把受损字符当作正文，网页保留了可折叠英文原文与具体页码；中文公式化改写仍处于人工校订中。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Why the α/r Scaling Matters Without scaling, doubling the rank r would roughly double the magnitude of ∆W = BA (more columns in B contribute to the sum). This means changing rank would also change how much the model is perturbed—you’d need to re-tune the learning rate every time you adjust r.

blocks.alt: Figure 1.10：LoRA 把权重更新 ΔW 分解为两个低秩矩阵 B×A。原始权重 W 保持冻结，仅 B 与 A 接收梯度；推理时可把 BA 合并回 W，因此不增加额外运行开销。
blocks.caption: Figure 1.10：LoRA 把权重更新 ΔW 分解为两个低秩矩阵 B×A。原始权重 W 保持冻结，仅 B 与 A 接收梯度；推理时可把 BA 合并回 W，因此不增加额外运行开销。

blocks.originalExcerpt: Key Extensions Explained DoRA – Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation. DoRA [228] observes that full finetuning tends to change the direction of weight vectors more than their magnitude. Standard LoRA conflates both. DoRA decomposes each weight column into magnitude m = ∥W ∥col and direction V̂ = W/∥W ∥col , then applies LoRA only to the direction:

blocks.text: W + BA W = m = ⊙ V̂ = V̂ + BA∥col
blocks.originalExcerpt: W + BA W ′ = m ⊙ V̂ ′ , V̂ ′ = ∥W + BA∥col

blocks.originalExcerpt: Magnitude m is a separate learnable vector (one scalar per column). This consistently outperforms LoRA by 1–3% on reasoning and instruction-following benchmarks with no additional inference cost (merged at deployment).

blocks.originalExcerpt: VeRA – Vector-based Random Matrix Adaptation. VeRA [190] takes parameter efficiency to the extreme: instead of learning A and B, it freezes them as shared random matrices across all layers and only trains two diagonal scaling vectors db ∈ Rr and da ∈ Rd :

blocks.text: 为何LORA Won LoRA成为标准，因为它独特的结合:(1) 零推论的间接性——适配器合并为基重，与适应器或前缀图宁不同，后者增加了耐久性或消耗上下文;(2) 可调性——在服务时间可互换多个LORA适配器进行多租户部署;(3) 生态系统支持——HuggingFace PEFT， TRL， vLLM，所有主要框架都具有一流的LORA支持;(4) 被证明是规模的—— 用于Meta， Google， 以及HuggingFace上的大多数开源微调。 除非LORA不能满足的有特定的制约， 否则应该是你的默认选择。

教育部的核心挑战是，上K选择不是不同的，你不能通过硬的“选择前2”操作来支撑支持。字段开发了两种关键技巧来解决这个问题: 路由器计算对每个专家的日志 h(x) = Wr = x， 然后选择顶端 k。 但是:
blocks.originalExcerpt: The core challenge in MoE is that top-k selection is not differentiable — you can’t backpropagate through a hard “pick the top 2” operation. The field has developed two key tricks to solve this: The Routing Differentiability Problem The router computes logits h(x) = Wr · x for each expert, then selects the top-k. But:

blocks.text: • 选定的专家通过门的权重(选定部分的软度)获得梯度
blocks.originalExcerpt: • The selected experts get gradients through their gate weights (softmax over selected)

blocks.text: • 选择决定本身(选择哪个k)的梯度为零
blocks.originalExcerpt: • The selection decision itself (which k to pick) has zero gradient

blocks.text: · 没有诡计，路由器就会卡住:一个从未被选中的专家 —— 从来没有获得梯度
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Without a trick, the router can get stuck: an expert never selected → never gets a gradient

blocks.text: 几弹的例子的主要设计原则:
blocks.originalExcerpt: Key design principles for few-shot examples:

blocks.text: 1. 多样性:涵盖预期投入的范围(长度、边缘案例、类别)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Diversity: Cover the range of expected inputs (different lengths, edge cases, categories).

blocks.text: 2. 排序:将更硬或更具代表性的例子放在最后(频率偏差)[241]。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Ordering: Place harder or more representative examples last (recency bias) [241].

blocks.text: 3. 标签平衡:如果进行分类，包括所有类别的例子，以避免多数阶级的偏见。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Label balance: If classifying, include examples from all classes to avoid majority-class bias.

blocks.text: 4. 格式一致性:每个实例必须遵循完全相同的结构。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 4. Format consistency: Every example must follow the exact same structure. The model mimics

blocks.text: 5. 相关性:使用与目标查询相似的例子，以获取最佳结果[223]。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 5. Relevance: Use examples semantically similar to the target query for best results [223].

blocks.text: 系统提示 vs 用户提示 现代聊天API 将系统提示(持久指令，角色定义)与用户消息(每回合输入)分离。系统提示在大多数模型中处理时会得到更高的关注优先，并为角色定义，约束，输出格式规格提供了自然位置[274]。
blocks.originalExcerpt: System prompts vs. user prompts. Modern chat APIs separate the system prompt (persistent instructions, role definition) from the user message (per-turn input). System prompts are processed with higher attention priority in most models and provide a natural place for role definitions, constraints, and output format specifications [274].

blocks.text: 阅读 §1.13.6「思维链(COT) 提示」 时，以页面标注的原文范围为证据边界：先确认术语定义，再追踪机制、前提、例子与限制，最后检查结论能否迁移到不同规模或不同数据条件。以下译述保留这些层次，不把编者判断混入原文。
思维链促进 [374] 要求模型在给出最后答案之前，先产生中间推理步骤。这种简单的技术极大地改善了在需要多步推理的任务上的性能:算术，逻辑，常识推论，和代码生成。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Chain-of-thought prompting [374] asks the model to produce intermediate reasoning steps before giving a final answer. This simple technique dramatically improves performance on tasks requiring multi-step reasoning: arithmetic, logic, commonsense inference, and code generation.

blocks.text: • 序列化计算:变形器有固定深度但可变长的生成。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Serializes computation: Transformers have fixed depth but variable-length generation. CoT

blocks.text: 将并行(硬)问题转换成顺序(易)步骤，有效地增加模型的计算预算。
blocks.originalExcerpt: converts parallel (hard) problems into sequential (easy) steps, effectively increasing the model’s computational budget.

blocks.text: • 减少复合错误:每一步是一个更简单的子问题，每步错误较少
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Reduces compounding errors: Each step is a simpler sub-problem with lower per-step error

blocks.text: • 暴露中间状态:使推理可以审计和调试。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Exposes intermediate state: Makes reasoning auditable and debuggable.

blocks.text: 任何即时的“几发式”可选办法[374]中加上“让我们一步一步思考”的“零射式可选办法说明”[367]，提供具有明确推理链的自相容性的例子[367];多数投票 最终答案 Tree of Thoughts [407] 探索多个推理分支，并带回溯计划-和-Solve [364] 第一步计划步骤;然后执行每个步骤 ReAct [408] 互换理性和Agent(工具使用)

blocks.text: 零热链式思维
blocks.originalExcerpt: Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought

blocks.text: 问:一家店有45个苹果。他们早上卖3/5个苹果，下午卖1/3个剩余苹果。还剩多少个苹果?
blocks.originalExcerpt: Q : A store has 45 apples . They sell 3/5 of them in the morning and 1/3 of the remaining in the afternoon . How many apples are left ?

blocks.text: 让我们一步一步思考。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Let ’s think step by step .
A : Morning sales : 45 * 3/5 = 27 apples sold . Remaining after morning : 45 - 27 = 18. Afternoon sales : 18 * 1/3 = 6 apples sold . Remaining : 18 - 6 = 12 apples .

blocks.text: 自相容性。 Wang等人 [367] 显示，取样多条思维链推理路径，对最终答案采取多数投票方式，明显优于单路径CoT。直觉:正确的推理路径往往会集中在同一个答案上，而错误通常是典型的。 这种交易(生成N样本)是为了精确性，在不重视延迟性而不太正确时，实用性。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Self-Consistency. Wang et al. [367] showed that sampling multiple chain-of-thought reasoning paths and taking a majority vote over final answers significantly outperforms single-path CoT. The intuition: correct reasoning paths tend to converge on the same answer, while errors are typically idiosyncratic. This trades compute (generating N samples) for accurac...

blocks.text: 当 CoT 伤害时。 CoT 并非普遍有益。 CoT 对于简单的任务(单步分类，检索，格式化)， CoT 添加不必要的符号，增加耐久性，甚至可以通过过度思考引入错误。选择性地使用 COT 来完成您期望需要多步推理的任务。
blocks.originalExcerpt: When CoT hurts. CoT is not universally beneficial. For simple tasks (single-step classification, retrieval, formatting), CoT adds unnecessary tokens, increases latency, and can even introduce errors through overthinking. Use CoT selectively for tasks where you expect multi-step reasoning to be required.

blocks.text: 阅读 §1.13.7「高级提示技术」 时，以页面标注的原文范围为证据边界：先确认术语定义，再追踪机制、前提、例子与限制，最后检查结论能否迁移到不同规模或不同数据条件。以下译述保留这些层次，不把编者判断混入原文。
RAG(RAG)。 RAG[208] 不仅不依靠模型的参数存储，还检索了相关文档，并把它们包括在了: 背景( retrieved) : [文档块] 问题:[用户查询]只根据所提供的上下文回答。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Rather than relying solely on the model’s parametric memory, RAG [208] retrieves relevant documents and includes them in the prompt: Context ( retrieved ) : [ document chunks ] Question : [ user query ] Answer based ONLY on the provided context .

blocks.text: 这为模型的反应提供了可核查的来源，并大大减少了知识密集型任务的幻觉。
blocks.originalExcerpt: This grounds the model’s responses in verifiable sources and dramatically reduces hallucinations for knowledge-intensive tasks.

blocks.text: 快速链和解析。复杂的任务从被突破到一个更简单的导线管道中，其中输出一个成为下一个输入:
blocks.originalExcerpt: Prompt Chaining and Decomposition. Complex tasks benefit from being broken into a pipeline of simpler prompts, where the output of one becomes the input to the next:

blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Extract key facts from document

blocks.text: 2. 事实推论的理由
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Reason over extracted facts

blocks.text: 3. 最后答复的格式
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Format final answer

blocks.text: 每个步骤可以使用不同的即时模板、模型或温度设置。这比单一的即时更能控制，并能够进行有针对性的调试。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Each step can use a different prompt template, model, or temperature setting. This is more controllable than a single monolithic prompt and enables targeted debugging.

blocks.text: 宪法AI/Self-Critic。 Bai等人[16] 引入了要求模型根据一套原则批评和修改其产出的提示: [产生初步回应] Critic:修订:改写针对批评的答复。

[16] introduce prompts that ask the model to critique and revise its own output against a set of principles: [ Generate initial response ] Critique : Does this response violate any of the following principles ? [ list principles ] Revision : Rewrite the response addressing the critique .

blocks.text: 注意理性查询(ARQ)。 ARQ [403] 解决了标准提示的基本弱点:随着上下文长度的增大，模型在提示中间的"丢失"关键信息(即中误效应)越来越"丢失"。 ARQ通过将复杂的查询分解成多个焦点子点来缓解这一点，每个子点都旨在引导模型的注意力集中在上下文的特定部分: 将一个复杂的查询分解成多个焦点子点，每个子点旨在引导模型的注意力集中在上下文的特定部分上下文: 将一个复杂的查询分解成多个焦点子点，每个子点将一个分解为多个焦点子点，每个分点都用于引导模型的注意力集中到上下文中去。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Attentive Reasoning Queries (ARQ). ARQ [403] addresses a fundamental weakness of standard prompting: as context length grows, models increasingly “lose” critical information in the middle of the prompt (the lost-in-the-middle effect). 知识蒸馏[139]将大型教师模型的学习行为转移到一个较小，更便宜的学生模型中。核心思想是，教师在象征性物上的输出分布，比仅地面真实的硬标签更能传递更丰富的信号 — — 揭示出学生可以利用的阶级间的相似性、校准性和不确定性。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Knowledge distillation [139] transfers the learned behaviour of a large teacher model into a smaller, cheaper student model. The core idea is that the teacher’s output distribution over tokens carries far richer signal than ground-truth hard labels alone — revealing inter-class similarities, calibration, and uncertainty that the student can exploit.

When only text outputs are available (e.g. distilling from a proprietary API), the student is trained via SFT on the teacher’s generations, optionally augmented with chain-of-thought traces. Motivation: Practical reality — most frontier models do not expose logits. Pros: Simple pipeline; works with any model behind an API.

blocks.originalExcerpt: Self-Distillation. A model distils from a larger version within the same architecture family (e.g. Llama-3 70B → 8B) or from its own checkpoints during training. Motivation: Avoid training a separate teacher; leverage the model’s own capacity at different scales. Pros: Architecture compatibility; no external dependency.

为什么鹰超人美杜莎·美杜莎的头部在每一个位置都独立预测——他们不能以自己先前的预测为条件(Tken at t + 2不知道t + 1的预测)。鹰用轻量级自动回转解码器来修正它，它运行在目标模型的隐藏状态上:
blocks.originalExcerpt: Why Eagle Outperforms Medusa Medusa’s heads predict independently at each position — they cannot condition on their own previous predictions (token at t + 2 doesn’t know what was predicted at t + 1). Eagle fixes this with a lightweight autoregressive decoder that operates on the target model’s hidden states:

blocks.text: 1. 从目标模型的最后一个层提取隐藏状态
blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Extract hidden states from the target model’s last layer

blocks.text: 2. 输入一个小(1层)解码器，自动生成有条件的草稿符号
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Feed into a small (1-layer) decoder that autoregressively generates draft tokens conditioned

blocks.text: 隐藏状态
blocks.originalExcerpt: on previous hidden states

blocks.text: 3. 这种方法反映了美杜莎所忽略的相互依赖关系。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. This captures inter-token dependencies that Medusa misses

blocks.text: 结果:鹰的接受率达到85-95%，美杜莎的接受率达到60-80%。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Result: Eagle achieves 85–95% acceptance rate vs. Medusa’s 60–80%.

N-gram 查寻方法 最简单的推测解码——不需要额外的模型或训练:
blocks.originalExcerpt: N-gram Lookup Method The simplest speculative decoding — requires no additional model or training:

blocks.text: 1. 保持从即时文本和以前生成的文本中缓存 n 克
blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Maintain a cache of n-grams from the prompt and previously generated text

blocks.text: 2. 在每一步， 请检查当前上下文的最后一个 n - 1 个符号是否匹配任何缓存的 n- gm
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. At each step, check if the current context’s last n − 1 tokens match any cached n-gram

blocks.text: 3. 如果有:提议作为代号草案继续使用
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. If yes: propose the continuation as draft tokens

blocks.text: 4. 与通常采用的目标模式进行核对
blocks.originalExcerpt: 4. Verify against target model as usual

blocks.text: 最佳的代码生成(重复模式)，结构化输出(JSON/XML)，以及带有重复元素的提示。 Cost: 基本上零。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Best for: Code generation (repetitive patterns), structured outputs (JSON/XML), and prompts with repeated elements. Cost: Essentially zero.

LLMs 生成可能事实上不正确的流利文本——一种叫做幻觉的现象[164]。本节涵盖模型一级的基本检测方法(不进行外部检索或多剂验证)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: LLMs generate fluent text that may be factually incorrect—a phenomenon called hallucination [164]. This section covers basic detection methods at the model level (without external retrieval or multiagent verification).

致幻分类学
blocks.originalExcerpt: Hallucination Taxonomy

blocks.text: • 内语:与所提供的输入/内容相矛盾(例如，摘要说与“内语”相反)
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Intrinsic: Contradicts the provided input/context (e.g., summary says the opposite of the

blocks.text: • 外向:产生无法从输入中核实且事实上错误的索赔
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Extrinsic: Generates claims that cannot be verified from the input and are factually wrong

blocks.text: • 忠诚:产出与教学或特定限制有差异
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Faithfulness: Output diverges from the instruction or specified constraints

blocks.originalExcerpt: Semantic Entropy. Kuhn et al. [193] observe that token-level entropy is unreliable (paraphrases have different tokens but same meaning). Instead, they generate multiple responses, cluster them by semantic equivalence (via NLI), and compute entropy over meaning clusters: X SE = − P (c) log P (c) c∈clusters

blocks.text: 高SE表示模型产生出不同的声音——强烈的幻觉信号。
blocks.originalExcerpt: High SE means the model produces semantically different answers—a strong hallucination signal.

blocks.text: SelfCheckGPT。 Manakul 等人[249]通过检查自相容性来检测幻觉:生成多个响应，并核实主响应中的说法是否得到替代品的支持。如果模型“不同意自己”的话，则可能幻觉地提出这种主张。 不需要外部知识。
blocks.originalExcerpt: SelfCheckGPT. Manakul et al. [249] detect hallucinations by checking self-consistency: generate multiple responses and verify whether claims in the main response are supported by the alternatives. If the model “disagrees with itself,” the claim is likely hallucinated. No external knowledge needed.

blocks.originalExcerpt: DoLA (Decoding by Contrasting Layers). Chuang et al. [58] observe that factual knowledge emerges in later transformer layers while earlier layers retain more generic/uncertain representations. DoLA contrasts the logit distributions between a later (“mature”) layer and an earlier (“premature”) layer at each decoding step:  DoLA(xt ) = softmax log Plate (xt )...

blocks.text: 通过将从更深层中编码的事实知识中发出的信号放大， DoLA在推论时减少幻觉，而无需再培训——只需要再多一个前行经过对比层。这种方法是对基于抽样的方法的补充，可以与这些方法结合起来。
blocks.originalExcerpt: By amplifying the signal from factual knowledge encoded in deeper layers, DoLA reduces hallucinations at inference time without any retraining—requiring only a single additional forward pass through the contrasted layer. It is complementary to sampling-based methods and can be combined with them.

blocks.text: 模型水平检测的局限性 这些方法检测不确定性，而不是不正确。 模型可能令人信服地错误(低等的反射，一致的反应—但事实上是虚假的 )。为了进行可靠的检测，与基于检索的核查(RAG)或外部事实检查工具相结合。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Limitations of Model-Level Detection These methods detect uncertainty, not incorrectness. A model can be confidently wrong (low entropy, consistent responses—but factually false). For reliable detection, combine with retrievalbased verification (RAG) or external fact-checking tools.

安全不是事后考虑，而是LLM培训管道的一个组成部分。 这一节涵盖了LLM安全的关键层面以及用于强制实施负责任行为的机制。

blocks.title: 编者阅读提示
blocks.text: 阅读 §1.17.4「帮助-安全权衡」 时，把每个 failure mode 拆成触发条件、可观测信号、影响范围、缓解措施和剩余风险。原书给出的警告不是附录信息，而是决定系统是否能进入生产环境的设计约束。
平衡帮助和安全过度优化安全造成了一个过度的反驳问题:模型会减少良性要求(例如拒绝在教育背景下讨论历史暴力)。目标是在安全限制范围内，制定最有利的政策:
blocks.originalExcerpt: Balancing Helpfulness and Safety Over-optimizing for safety creates an over-refusal problem: the model declines benign requests (e.g., refusing to discuss historical violence in an educational context). The goal is a Pareto-optimal policy that is maximally helpful within safety constraints:
max E[Rhelpful ] subject to E[Rsafety ] ≥ τ θ

blocks.text: 在实践中，这是作为加权奖励执行的:R=αRhelpful +(1−α)安全，仔细调整α(一般为0.6-0.8)。 Meta的Llama-3报告采用了独特的安全和有用性奖励模式，并采用比值加权法[118]。
blocks.originalExcerpt: In practice, this is implemented as a weighted reward: R = αRhelpful + (1 − α)Rsafety with careful tuning of α (typically 0.6–0.8). Meta’s Llama-3 reports using distinct safety and helpfulness reward models with margin-based weighting [118].

blocks.text: 安全永远不完全 技术组合不会提供绝对的安全性。 新的攻击矢量被不断发现(多模式的越狱、微调攻击，从而消除安全训练、多发催动)。安全需要不断监测，对新的威胁作出快速反应，并进行深入的防御(多个独立的层)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Safety Is Never Complete No combination of techniques provides absolute safety. New attack vectors are discovered continuously (multi-modal jailbreaks, fine-tuning attacks that remove safety training, many-shot prompting). Safety requires ongoing monitoring, rapid response to new threats, and defense-indepth (multiple independent layers).

summary: 本节涵盖LLM的基础架构以及使培训和推论效率提高的关键优化技术。题目是作为课程来定的:我们从Transformer本身开始，然后是怎样有效地训练它，怎样便宜地改造它，怎样压缩它，怎样扩大它，怎样加速它的推论。
